title: Album Club (Mune Kyun): St. Paulia Jogakuin
native_title: アルバム倶楽部 「胸キュン」 ～セント・ポーリア女学院～
overview:
Album Club: Mune Kyun Saint Paulia Jogakuin puts you in charge of the photos for the 100th anniversary album of Saint Paulia girls' school. Since men are not allowed on campus, you work through a robot cameraman.

Search the school grounds for the six students and one teacher you need to photograph, from flashy girls to shy girls in glasses. Other people you meet offer hints or extra film. Talk to a subject to start negotiating, then beat her at Acchi Muite Hoi to win a photo session. The scene switches from anime art to live-action video, and you press the shutter at the moment you choose. Your film is limited, so fill the album with all seven before you run out. Photos can be viewed again at any time. For adults only.
